title: [master]Incorrect Purchase Credit Memo created when Customer and Vendor Subscription Contracts have the same Contract Number.
summary: Billing totals now filter by both Subscription Contract No. and Partner type to prevent incorrect credit memos when customer and vendor contracts share the same number.
key_points: Added Partner filtering in GetServiceAmountForContract and GetServiceAmount methods
Prevents customer credit memo lines from affecting vendor contract billing totals
Fixes issue where shared contract numbers caused wrong document type (credit memo instead of invoice)
Changes affect billing line calculations and codeunit logic
Comprehensive test coverage added for the correction scenario
